Woh prajati jeevit nahi rehti jo sabse majboot hai, balki woh jo sabse aasaani se dhal jaati hai.
Shak ek sukhad sthiti nahi hai, lekin poora vishwas bhi beukooafi hai.
"Believe karo—tum halfway pahunch gaye."
Success paana hai, happiness milne par khush rehna.
Optimism ek choice hai.
"Success choti efforts ka sum hai—repeat."
"Abhi tumhare andar sab kuch hai jo chahiye."
Discomfort greatness ka price hai.
"Sirf chahna nahi—kaam karo."
"Progress banao—excuses nahi."
"Kal jitna socha, usse zyada hard work."
Jo paas hai wo dekho, hamesha zyada milega.
Aaj ka shaq, kal ki rukawat.
